gherkin.scenario: Adding a review to a whishlisted article
given: I am on the OneStopShop site and logged in as emma.lopez@gmail.com
when: Go to the Home Page and add an item to the wish list by clicking on a heart
Choose the article in the Wish List and click on "Edit"
Click on the Review Tab at the bottom

Fill the following field:
 - "Your Rating"
 - "Nickname"
 - "Summary"
 - "Review"
Click on the "Submit Review" button.
then: A green message: "the review has been added" is displayed

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: A green message: "the review has been added" is displayed
